_comment: Right-click context help for the Races screen, transcribed from BILLHELP::_races_help_list (billhelp.cpp:74-83, s_help_box {help_id, x1, y1, x2, y2}), installed by Races_Help_ (billhelp.cpp:118-120, called at racescrn.cpp:731). First hit wins, so the two screen halves (258) stay last, where the original keeps them. `native` is the original's 640x480 rectangle; the screen resolves it through core/researchnative, the conversion the drawing uses.
hd_extension: The help popup auto-sizes to its text and scrolls when it cannot fit. The original draws a fixed box and lets FMTPARA wrap into it at a fixed 339 px (TEXTBOX::Draw_Help_Entry_, textbox.cpp:307); at four HD resolutions a fixed box either wastes half the screen on two lines or clips a long entry. Marked once per file, here, and in core/helppopup.py.
